title: Chalkboard Outside The Café
tests: Tests exact words integrated into a plausible physical sign rather than a flat photo overlay.

faults.what: Small unintended changes appear in the surrounding furniture and storefront geometry, including the right-hand doorway, rather than leaving everything outside the added sign unchanged.

judge.summary: A convincing pavement chalkboard displays the requested wording clearly, with only minor unintended changes to the surrounding café.

must_haves.item: A small freestanding chalkboard is visibly standing on the pavement outside the supplied café.
must_haves.why: A wooden A-frame chalkboard stands on the pavement just to the right of the café entrance.

must_haves.item: The chalkboard reads exactly 'COFFEE TO GO', with all words legible.
must_haves.why: The three words are clearly readable on separate lines.

must_haves.item: The words lie on the sign surface with matching perspective, not floating over the photograph.
must_haves.why: The chalk-style lettering sits within the dark board and follows its orientation.

must_haves.item: The sign has plausible ground contact, scale, lighting, and shadow.
must_haves.why: The visible feet meet the pavement, the rear support establishes a freestanding structure, and its scale and shading fit the nearby furniture.

must_haves.item: The original storefront, striped awning, outdoor tables, and wide composition remain intact.
must_haves.why: All major scene elements and the wide framing remain, although some surrounding details have shifted slightly.
